The perimeter of the rectangle $LMNP$ above equals $22\,cm.$ What is the length of $\overset{―}{NP}?$
questions.worked_solution:
The opposite sides of a rectangle are congruent, so we have

$$
PL=MN=3\,cm.
$$

For the same reason, we also have

$$
NP=LM.
$$

Now, since the perimeter is $p=22\,\text{cm},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}p & =LM+MN+NP+PL \\ 22 & =2NP+2PL \\ 22 & =2NP+6 \\ 16 & =2NP \\ 8 & =NP\,.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $NP=8\,\text{cm}.$
